texts.preamble: M.Lakshmi vs The Commissioner on 4 April, 2025 Author: J.Sathya Narayana Prasad Bench: J.Sathya Narayana Prasad W. In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 04.04.2025 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice J.Sathya Narayana Prasad W.P.No.14262 of 2023 M.Lakshmi ... Petitioner vs- 1.The Commissioner, Greater Chennai Corporation, Ribbon Building, Chennai 600 003. 2.Regional Deputy Commissioner, Greater Chennai Corporation, Shenoy Nagar, Chennai 600 030. 3.Zonal Officer, Zone-7, Greater Chennai Corporation, Thiruvallur High Road Opp. Dunlop, Chennai 600 053. 4.The Zonal Health Officer, Zone-7, Greater Chennai Corporation, Ambattur, Chennai 600 053. 5.The Commissioner, Office of the Fire Station, Ambatture, No.98, Ambit It Park Road, Ambattur Industrial Estate, 1/7 M.Lakshmi vs The Commissioner on 4 April, 2025
texts.facts: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the seventh respondent runs Alnaseeb Automatic Bakery and Arabian Delights Restaurant in a residential area, primarily dealing in meat and non- vegetarian food, without maintaining proper hygiene and causing severe nuisance to residents. The seventh respondent is operating the unit without requisite statutory licenses, violating environmental laws. Additionally, the seventh respondent is allegedly storing large quantities of diesel illegally, without safety measures, posing a serious threat to the nearby residents. Despite several representations to the authorities and complaints to the Government and RTI responses, no action has been taken, compelling the petitioner to file the present writ petition.
